description: This file defines configuration structures and functions for OpenTelemetry tracing, including TracerConfig, SpanConfig, EventConfig, and related options and methods.

classes.name: TracerConfig
classes.description: Configuration options for a tracer, including instrumentation version, schema URL, and attributes.

classes.name: SpanConfig
classes.description: Configuration options for a span, including attributes, timestamp, links, span kind, and whether it is a root span.

classes.name: EventConfig
classes.description: Configuration options for an event, including attributes, timestamp, and stack trace flag.

classes.name: TracerOption
classes.description: Interface for applying options to TracerConfig.

classes.name: SpanStartOption
classes.description: Interface for options applicable at span start.

classes.name: SpanEndOption
classes.description: Interface for options applicable at span end.

classes.name: EventOption
classes.description: Interface for options applicable to events.

classes.name: SpanOption
classes.description: Interface for options applicable at both span start and end.

classes.name: SpanStartEventOption
classes.description: Interface for options applicable at span start or with an event.

classes.name: SpanEndEventOption
classes.description: Interface for options applicable at span end or with an event.

methods.name: InstrumentationVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the instrumentation library.

methods.name: InstrumentationAttributes
methods.description: Returns attributes associated with the instrumentation library.

methods.name: SchemaURL
methods.description: Returns the schema URL of the tracer.

methods.name: Attributes
methods.description: Returns the attributes of a span.

methods.name: Timestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of a span or event.

methods.name: StackTrace
methods.description: Indicates if stack trace capturing is enabled.

methods.name: Links
methods.description: Returns links associated with a span.

methods.name: NewRoot
methods.description: Indicates if the span is a root span.

methods.name: SpanKind
methods.description: Returns the role of the span in a trace.

methods.name: NewSpanStartConfig
methods.description: Creates a new SpanConfig with start options applied.

methods.name: NewSpanEndConfig
methods.description: Creates a new SpanConfig with end options applied.

methods.name: Attributes
methods.description: Adds attributes to span or event configurations.

methods.name: WithAttributes
methods.description: Creates a span start event option with specified attributes.

methods.name: WithTimestamp
methods.description: Sets the timestamp for a span or event.

methods.name: WithStackTrace
methods.description: Enables or disables stack trace capturing.

methods.name: WithLinks
methods.description: Adds links to a span.

methods.name: WithNewRoot
methods.description: Marks a span as a root span.

methods.name: WithSpanKind
methods.description: Sets the span kind.

methods.name: WithInstrumentationVersion
methods.description: Sets the instrumentation version.

methods.name: mergeSets
methods.description: Merges two attribute sets, with values from the second overriding the first in case of duplicates.

methods.name: WithInstrumentationAttributes
methods.description: Adds instrumentation attributes by merging with existing.

methods.name: WithInstrumentationAttributeSet
methods.description: Adds a set of instrumentation attributes.

methods.name: WithSchemaURL
methods.description: Sets the schema URL for the tracer.
